summary.description: Where the run's time and money went, in three sentences at most, with no number of your own: a digit is refused and you are asked again but inside a word the report holds as an id or one of your citations writes as its path (c@1, a step named build2) - the figures are the pain points', in their impacts and their evidence.

painPoints.description: Each thing to change, ordered by what it cost - the most first; empty where the report shows nothing a change would have paid for.

title.description: One line a person who never saw the run understands: what to change, and where, with no number of your own: a digit is refused and you are asked again but inside a word the report holds as an id or one of your citations writes as its path (c@1, a step named build2).

severity.description: How much it matters: critical, high, medium or low, as a review grades its findings.

where.description: The steps it names, each by the id of its row in the report's steps - its instance id; a step the report's steps do not hold is refused and you are asked again.

evidence.description: The report's own values it rests on, each a citation: the section, the row by its id, the member and the value exactly as the report holds it. A citation the report does not hold is refused and you are asked again.

section.description: The report's section that holds it.

row.description: The id of the row that holds it, as the row's own id member says it - a step's and a critical path link's its instance, a failed attempt's <instance>@<attempt>, a signal's <kind>#<n>, a question's its id, a dollars group's its name, a convergence row's its id; empty where the member sits in the section itself (theRun, totals).

of.description: The member of the row that holds it, a path of members joined by '.' where it is inside one: seconds, usd, tokens.input, budget.usd.

said.description: The value as the report holds it: a number as the report writes it (30, 0.03) - read for its value - a text word for word.

impact.description: The time and dollars it cost, as a template with no number of your own: write every figure as a placeholder naming one of this point's citations by its place in evidence - {1} the first, {2} the second - and the tool writes it as the cited value with the unit the report holds that member in, as the report writes it (a time in seconds, 412.3 s; the budget's reasoning in minutes, 90.0 minutes; a cost in dollars, 0.0200 USD; a cache share in percent, 28.0%; tokens, 180000 tokens; any other count with what it counts, 2 tries; a number that is no amount after its label, exit 20), so write no unit beside it: build waited {1} on the critical path and cost {2}. A placeholder stands apart: one a letter, a number, a currency's sign or % touches, or a sign before it (${1}, {1}h, {1}%, -{1}), is refused, and so are one past your evidence and one whose citation holds no number the report measures (a text of words). A digit anywhere else is refused and you are asked again - 412.3, 3600s, $0.02, 2x, a date or a time of day alike - but inside a word the report holds as an id (a row's id or a name it is made of, a section's or a member's name) or one of your citations writes as its path (c@1, a step named build2).

cause.description: What the records show of why: no guessing - where the cause is not in the report or the records, it goes under noted instead - with no number of your own: a digit is refused and you are asked again but inside a word the report holds as an id or one of your citations writes as its path (c@1, a step named build2).

recommendation.description: The change to make: a configuration key, a workflow step's key, a prompt's line or a repository fix - the exact text where it is a key, as the configuration or the yml spells it. It states the values it proposes and is never a measurement: the figures are the impact's and the evidence's.

noted.description: What you saw and could not confirm, each with why; empty where you confirmed everything you said.

what.description: What you saw, with no number of your own: a digit is refused and you are asked again but inside a word the report holds as an id or one of your citations writes as its path (c@1, a step named build2).

why.description: Why you could not confirm it from the report or the run's records, with no number of your own: a digit is refused and you are asked again but inside a word the report holds as an id or one of your citations writes as its path (c@1, a step named build2).
